$$\Delta E_p = mg d\sin\theta = (1000)(10)(100)(0.05) = 50000\text{ J} = 50\text{ kJ}$$

Sum the energy increases to find total mechanical energy gain:
$$\Delta E = \Delta E_k + \Delta E_p = 150000 + 50000 = 200000\text{ J} = 200\text{ kJ}$$

Sum total mechanical gain:
- Adding both components:
$$\Delta E = 150 + 50 = 200\text{ kJ}$$
The car gains $200\text{ kJ}$ of mechanical energy.

$$W_{\text{engine}} = 320 - 125.6 = 194.4 \approx 194\text{ kJ}$$
